correctness.rationale: For every finite field F_q, the trace pairing on M2 is nondegenerate even when char=2. Non-scalar A has 2-dimensional centralizer kI+kA; for nonzero trace-zero Z the admissible A count is q^3-q, each with q^2 solutions B, yielding G_q(Z)=q^5-q^3. The zero target has G_q(0)=q^6+q^5-q^3. A common one-dimensional image for A and B forces Z to be rank-one nilpotent with image that line; prescribed nonzero determinant count K=q(q^2-1), and commuting shared-line count D=q^3+q^2-q (including the unique zero pair). Translation rank two contributes q^2 preimages and rank one q^3 only on its line, giving five target classes. The populations sum q^5 and their fiber-weighted sum q^12. Independent direct enumeration of ALL ordered inputs q=2 (4096) and q=3 (531441) agrees target-by-target, including trace-nonzero impossibility; these checks do not prove the all-field theorem.
